864-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
864-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Eternal Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

678-4022-6797.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
678-4022-6797.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Repeat.

6529-7084-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
6529-7084-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-2393-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-2393-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sifter of Skulls triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1170-1976-5131-5315--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1976-5131-5315--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

3901-5166--86.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Wrathful Red Dragon to take damage.
3901-5166--86.description:
Cause Wrathful Red Dragon to take damage by any method.
Wrathful Red Dragon triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Wrathful Red Dragon.
Repeat from step 2.

1870-4873-5087-7290.easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor and Eternity Vessel have at least twenty charge counters combined.
1870-4873-5087-7290.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield at instant speed.
Does Machines is level 3.
There is at least one counter of any kind on The Ozolith.
1870-4873-5087-7290.description:
At the beginning of combat, Does Machines's last ability and The Ozolith trigger.
Resolve the Does Machines trigger, making Eternity Vessel a creature.
In response to the remaining trigger, cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
Resolve The Ozolith trigger from step 1, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.

215-3291-4927.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 6.
215-3291-4927.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-4742-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-4742-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-4742-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-5434-6974.manaNeeded: {3} if Ashling's Command is in your hand
339-677-5434-6974.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
If Ashling's Command is in your graveyard, activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Ashling's Command from your graveyard without paying its mana cost. Otherwise, cast Ashling's Command by paying {3}{U}{R}.
Resolve Ashling's Command, creating a token copy of Jegantha and choosing any of its remaining modes.
Put the tapped Jegantha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat using the Jegantha token.

147-7431.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Daydream.
147-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Daydream, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Daydream, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment

74-943-1556.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Scorched Ruins.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Scorched Ruins.
Repeat.
74-943-1556.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other land except Scorched Ruins instead.

930-997-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-3967-7060.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-7060.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

874-2854-4574-5741.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
874-2854-4574-5741.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2854-4574-5741.description:
Cast Delif's Cone either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

396-4050-4484-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
396-4050-4484-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

478-6071-6871.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three permanent cards in your graveyard.
478-6071-6871.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping The Core and Candelabra of Tawnos as it is a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

1323-4687-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Forests.
1323-4687-5709.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Rofellos's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

500-851-2523-4365.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Adrix and Nev and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Adrix and Nev token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Adrix and Nevs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Adrix and Nevs you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-851-2523-4365.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^308.0343553279263) creature tokens.

2267-4050-5751-5763.description:
Cast Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {1}{G} and discarding a land card.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
When Circle of the Land Druid enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature token and Circle of the Land Druid, adding {1}{G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

167-1126-4871.description:
During your precombat main phase, cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Xiahou Dun.
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it, targeting Not Dead After All.
When Xiahou Dun dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer triggers, as well as any Wicked Roles that were attached to Xiahou Dun.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger(s), if applicable, causing each opponent to lose that much life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun ability from step 2, returning Not Dead After All from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

944-3682-4518-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Kor Skyfisher from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2792-3489-5262.notablePrerequisites:
Throat Slitter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{B}{B}.
2792-3489-5262.description:
Declare Throat Slitter as an attacker.
When it isn't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{B}.
Activate Great Whale's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{B} and returning Throat Slitter from the battlefield to your hand, putting Great Whale onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Throat Slitter's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{B} and returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand, putting Throat Slitter onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2034-2471-3184.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Zabaz, adding {C}{C}.
When Zabaz dies, Yomiji triggers, returning Zabaz from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Zabaz by paying {1}.
Repeat.

141-4050-5132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one legendary planeswalker or creature.
141-4050-5132.description:
Cast Primevals' Glorious Rebirth by paying {5}{W}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Primevals' Glorious Rebirth.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the copy of Primevals' Glorious Rebirth, returning all legendary permanent cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
